notes:
What's new in 0.1.140:
- Live TV: a channel whose source ends by itself (a short clip, or an internet TV stream that drops) now plays to its end and stops cleanly. Before, phones could freeze a few seconds in, and the clip could start again from the beginning.
- Films shared with this home (new, OFF unless you turn it on): More > Shared with you has a new setting, "Show films shared with this home in my Films and TV lists". When the owner turns it on, this PC connects to each home that shared its library with you and adds their films and shows to the owner's Films and TV lists in the phone and TV apps. Only the owner's profile sees them. Profiles with parental limits never see shared films. Playing a shared film from these lists is not built yet, and this window and the browser pages do not show them yet, so leave the setting off unless you are trying it out.
- Kitchen announcements: a phone, TV or browser that opens Beebo on the home Wi-Fi while a message is still inside its 15 seconds now shows it, only for the seconds it has left. A message already shown is not shown again. The note after sending says plainly who can get announcements: only screens with Beebo open on the same home Wi-Fi as this computer.
- Beebo Relay in Settings > Away from home: the notices that say why Beebo Relay cannot be used, that Beebo will ask again automatically, or that Beebo Relay could not be turned off are now translated into German, Spanish, French, Italian and Brazilian Portuguese.
- Sidebar: the Converted count now counts a finished conversion only while both the new copy and the original are still on disk. If you removed one of them yourself, it drops out of the count. Nothing is deleted.
- Music: picking an album while a mix is still starting now frees that mix's tile, and the Albums list fills in when a library scan finishes.
- Windows only. The phone app and Beebo Auto are separate releases.
- Automated checks: the full Windows desktop test suite was run on the release source (2,176 test files, 22,252 tests): 22,106 passed and 0 failed; 109 tests in 34 files were skipped, so they were not run (mostly checks that need Linux, file links, an optional browser package or an opt-in switch), and 37 are marked as future work. The signed installer passed its signature, size, converter, connection-helper and language checks. No person has installed 0.1.140 yet, so its changes and its in-app update from 0.1.139 have not been tried by a person.
- Release source commit a9653db9c.
